name: smwpatches-drop-items-below-the-player-in-the-air
title: Drop Items Below the Player in the Air
description:
This patch let's the player drop items below them instead of next to them, but only in the air.

Useful for Kaizo Hacks that focus on item tricks.
Check the ASM file for some customization options.

This Patch is compatible with Item Release Bulk Patch.
